descriptionFull: The yellow-throated vireo ( Vireo flavifrons ) is a small American songbird."Vireo" is a Latin word referring to a green migratory bird, perhaps the female golden oriole, possibly the European greenfinch. The specific flavifrons is from the Latin words flavus , "yellow", and frons , "forehead".
